title: Russian DNA phantom experiments

tellings.quote: In the 1990s, Russian scientists described something even more bizarre. In their so-called DNA phantom experiments

plain: In the 1990s, Russian scientists described what they called DNA phantom experiments, which Michels calls even more bizarre than what came before in his account. He tells it himself, without naming the scientists or a source, and gives little detail of what the experiments found; he raises it as a sign that DNA may behave in ways mainstream science does not expect.
